Biennial Elections for Council Seats Scheduled for October 23

Biennial elections for five seats in the Legislative Council, specifically for Graduate and Teachers' constituencies, are scheduled to be held on October 23. These seats cover the Aurangabad, Pune, Nagpur, and Amravati divisions. Separately, Karnataka is also holding council polls for its graduates and teachers constituencies on the same date.
